lane: Adult clinical EMDR / explicitly visual variants

databaseRetrieval.note: Broad Europe PMC queries can match references/full text; retrieval is not screening. Metadata preserved privately.

screening.duplicateCaution: Two near-identical Research Square preprints have different DOIs; both deferred and treated as one probable study family, neither assessed.

findings: Direct adult-DV literature includes a negative five-person prisoner series, a nonrandomized 36-person pilot, a single case, and two small nonprofit-agency evaluations. No new verified adult-IPV RCT was established in this lane.
Tarquinio 2012 explicitly did not randomize participants; it receives zero design crosses.
Schwarz agency reports have unresolved cohort overlap; the later publication also has a 2021/2023 indexing date conflict and remains deferred.

Childhood-abuse trials are related transfer evidence. NTR5991 required childhood abuse by a caretaker/authority and excluded ongoing physical/sexual abuse. Wigard required repeated interpersonal childhood trauma without verified familial perpetration across the cohort. Edmond abstract does not identify perpetrator relationships.

The Molero 2026 same-family follow-up describes frequently intrafamilial CSA, but lacks an exact proportion; only nine of 31 eligible women completed both treatment phases. It is not independent replication of Molero 2024.
Clinical EMDR results do not isolate eye movements from psychotherapy and do not validate self-administered visual or audiovisual content.
Null comparisons and adverse findings remain visible. None of the included evidence earns two crosses.
